baselineObservation.rule: This is an immutable observation bound to baselineMainSha, not a live GitHub mirror.

A.question: Does ICTC governance preserve the promise of intent completion under epistemic governance?

B.question: Does ICTC remain one governance chain without competing owners?

C.question: Do canonical, typical, edge and stress human-AI interactions converge without intent laundering, false autonomy or hidden epistemic debt?

linkage.rule: A, B and C are independently falsified. Global qualification requires all three green on the same baseline bindings; no majority vote or partial green is sufficient.
sharedInvariants: human intent is preserved as input, not rewritten into technical authority
exactly one governed next action or an explicit STOP/BLOCKED state is exposed
Git/GitHub live facts are not replaced by repository projections
external E3-HUMAN, E3-GOV and E4-DEPLOY rails are never closed by CI or semantic mutation
merge is not release, qualification, Enterprise Candidate or completion
epistemic debt and uncertainty remain visible when they block stronger claims

claimBoundary: E2 repository/control-plane qualification bound to baselineMainSha. The suite does not prove representative-human usability, production effectiveness, legal compliance, protected-branch enforcement, deployment security, Enterprise Candidate, Enterprise Ready or formal global minimality. Semantic mutation is not physical proof.
